description.en: The current revision covers Carolingian partitions, court relocations, Sui integration and earlier contexts. Dates between records replay a recorded model; they do not certify continuous historical coverage.
description.zh-CN: 当前数据版本涵盖加洛林分割、宫廷迁驻、隋的整合及更早的背景。记录之间的日期只回放已收录模型，不代表连续完整的历史覆盖。

dataset.license: Apache-2.0 (GitWorld-authored records); cited third-party works retain their own rights

notes.en: Initial reviewed seed: original summaries, citation-only references, explicit limits and model resolutions. Editorial preparation is AI-assisted, not specialist certification.
notes.zh-CN: 初始种子：原创摘要、仅引用的来源、明确的局限与模型决议。编辑准备由 AI 辅助，不代表史学专家认证。

summary.en: Frankish rulers build an imperial claim; inheritance and negotiated partitions reshape their realm.
summary.zh-CN: 法兰克统治者确立帝国名号；继承与协商分割不断重塑其领地。

summary.en: The Abbasids take power in the east while an Umayyad ruler establishes a new base in al-Andalus.
summary.zh-CN: 阿拔斯在东方掌权，一位倭马亚统治者则在安达卢斯建立新的统治中心。

summary.en: Explore selected court, political and cultural records: Sui integration, Tang–Japan planning connections and earlier Qin rule.
summary.zh-CN: 探索精选宫廷、政治与文化记录：隋的整合、唐日规划联系，以及更早的秦朝统治。

summary.en: A dynasty’s inheritance repeatedly changes the political map.
summary.zh-CN: 同一王朝的继承，反复改变政治格局。

summary.en: Papal support helps secure Pippin’s new royal dynasty.
summary.zh-CN: 教宗的支持帮助丕平巩固新王朝。

name.en: The Abbasid court changes its seat

summary.en: A new dynasty establishes its court in Iraq; selected records follow Baghdad, Samarra and a return to Baghdad.
summary.zh-CN: 新王朝在伊拉克建立宫廷；精选记录追踪巴格达、萨迈拉，以及返回巴格达的过程。

name.zh-CN: 倭马亚在安达卢斯的延续

summary.en: After the dynasty loses power in the east, Abd al-Rahman I builds an emirate in Iberia.
summary.zh-CN: 失去东方的统治后，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼一世在伊比利亚建立埃米尔国。

summary.en: The dynasty survives a major rebellion with its court’s authority weakened.
summary.zh-CN: 王朝在大规模叛乱后延续，但朝廷的权威受到削弱。

name.zh-CN: 日本朝廷的迁都与返回

summary.en: The court leaves Nara, returns, then moves through Nagaoka to Heian. A return to a city need not restore its earlier state.
summary.zh-CN: 朝廷离开奈良后又返回，随后迁往长冈、平安。回到同一座城市，并不意味着恢复此前的状态。

name.en: From divided rule to Sui integration
name.zh-CN: 从分立统治到隋朝整合

summary.en: Sui rule begins in the north; the end of Chen brings the southern realm into the same modeled outcome.
summary.zh-CN: 隋先在北方建立统治；陈的终结使南方领地进入同一建模结果。

summary.en: A Baekje royal gift has two traditional dates; earlier private practice remains possible.
summary.zh-CN: 百济王室赠礼存在两种传统纪年；此前民间可能已信仰佛教。

summary.en: The imperial title and a later policy on texts provide two selected states before the Common Era.
summary.zh-CN: 皇帝称号与稍后的焚书政策，提供两个公元前的精选状态。

summary.en: After Pippin’s death, Charlemagne and Carloman divide the Frankish kingdom.
summary.zh-CN: 丕平去世后，查理曼与卡洛曼分承法兰克王国。

summary.en: Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne emperor in Rome.
summary.zh-CN: 教宗利奥三世在罗马为查理曼加冕，授予皇帝称号。

summary.en: Charlemagne dies; his surviving son Louis the Pious inherits the empire.
summary.zh-CN: 查理曼去世，在世的儿子虔诚者路易继承帝国。

summary.en: Louis’s sons settle their conflict with a three-way partition at Verdun.
summary.zh-CN: 路易的儿子们在凡尔登达成三分协议，结束彼此的争战。

summary.en: Charles the Bald and Louis the German partition Lotharingia at Meerssen.
summary.zh-CN: 秃头查理与日耳曼人路易在梅尔森瓜分洛塔林吉亚。

summary.en: With papal support, Pippin is elected king of the Franks.
summary.zh-CN: 在教宗支持下，丕平被推举为法兰克国王。

summary.en: Pope Stephen II anoints Pippin and his sons Charles and Carloman.
summary.zh-CN: 教宗斯德望二世为丕平及其两子查理、卡洛曼施行涂油礼。

summary.en: The Abbasid revolution overthrows Umayyad rule in the east.
summary.zh-CN: 阿拔斯革命推翻倭马亚在东方的统治。

summary.en: Al-Mansur establishes Baghdad as the Abbasid capital.
summary.zh-CN: 曼苏尔将巴格达确立为阿拔斯的都城。

summary.en: Samarra becomes the caliphal residence, a role it retains until 892.
summary.zh-CN: 萨迈拉成为哈里发驻地，并保持这一地位直至 892 年。

summary.en: Abd al-Rahman I establishes Umayyad rule in al-Andalus.
summary.zh-CN: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼一世在安达卢斯建立倭马亚统治。

title.zh-CN: 科尔多瓦大清真寺开建

summary.en: Abd al-Rahman I begins the Great Mosque of Córdoba.
summary.zh-CN: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼一世开始修建科尔多瓦大清真寺。

summary.en: Li Yuan establishes the Tang dynasty after the Sui collapse.
summary.zh-CN: 隋朝瓦解后，李渊建立唐朝。

summary.en: A frontier commander turns his forces against the Tang court.
summary.zh-CN: 一位边镇将领率军反叛唐朝朝廷。

summary.en: The rebellion ends, but the Tang court’s power remains weakened.
summary.zh-CN: 叛乱结束，但唐朝朝廷的权力仍受到削弱。

summary.en: Heijō-kyō at Nara adopts a grid inspired by Tang Chang’an, without its enclosing walls.
summary.zh-CN: 奈良的平城京借鉴唐长安的棋盘格局，但没有外围城墙。

summary.en: The court leaves Heijō-kyō for Nagaoka-kyō.
summary.zh-CN: 朝廷离开平城京，迁往长冈京。

summary.en: The court moves to Heian-kyō, at present-day Kyoto.
summary.zh-CN: 朝廷迁往平安京，即今天的京都。

description.zh-CN: 路易的东部王国及其 870 年所得洛塔林吉亚份额；尚未收录此后的统治。

name.zh-CN: 倭马亚统治下的科尔多瓦

description.en: A southern ruling house before Sui conquest; the route terminates at integration.
description.zh-CN: 隋征服前的南方统治家族；此路径在整合时终止。

description.en: A record with two traditional dates. It does not date the first private practice of Buddhism.
description.zh-CN: 这条记录保留两种传统纪年，并不确定民间最早信仰佛教的时间。

description.en: Selected imperial records; no direct ancestry is asserted from Qin to the medieval paths.

summary.zh-CN: 丕平即位，加洛林家族开始掌握王权。
